justification: PR-1 of the CDC screen consolidation (#820, plan ce-cdc-screen-consolidation-2026-07): new dark backend engine (services/cdc_screen.py) + additive migration 058 for cdc_eligibility_standards. Nothing is wired to any surface yet — the conveyancing PDF and workbench route are untouched — but the engine renders regulatory verdicts once wired, and the loader/validation contract must be right now, so standard tier not minor. Hardened per Sol review of the PR: lifecycle (is_active + one-active partial unique index), conditional min-lot evaluation, proposal-scoped dual-occ prohibition, flood/bushfire/HCA demoted to 'likely' (broad overlay booleans are not instrument exclusions), strict acid-sulfate validation, NaN input coercion.

pre_impl.existing_data: Prior-art sweep (after two earlier misses this session, both user-corrected): the Codes SEPP 2008 is fully ingested (~70 documents, 5,213 regulatory_provisions rows — id 22630 cl 1.19 land exemptions, id 36185 significantly-contaminated-land exclusion, id 14240 cl 6.4(1)(d)(ii) conditional 200 m2 minimum); the workbench already runs a 10-check TS screen at /api/cdc/preliminary-check with hardcoded zone lists/thresholds; development_pathways holds a 1-row prototype of criteria-with-provenance. This engine replaces the TS hardcodes' role, sourced from a new provenance-cited table.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Two values the TS route hardcodes did not survive grounding: the flat '200 m2 minimum' is actually conditional in the instrument (cl 6.4(1)(d)(ii): applies only if no minimum is specified), so the standards table carries a conditionality column and the exclusion reason quotes it; the FSR<0.3 warning had no instrument grounding at all and is dropped from the engine. Mine subsidence turned out not to be a Codes SEPP exclusion (no hit in the instrument text) — modelled as a warning about the separate Subsidence Advisory NSW approval, never an exclusion.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: New table (additive migration, schema only — no seed rows, no existing table touched) and new service module. No surface behaviour changes in this PR: the engine is dark until standards rows are seeded, founder-verified (manual_verified flag), and PR-2 wires the PDF row and swaps the route internals. Verdict semantics copied from the existing route: never 'yes', only 'no' with cited exclusions or 'maybe' with certifier disclaimer.

functions.name: load_cdc_standards
functions.input: psycopg2 connection and code_name, reading only manual_verified rows from cdc_eligibility_standards
functions.output: standards dict with eligible zone set, minimum lot size, conditionality text, optional acid sulfate class, and per-standard clause refs
functions.if_none: missing connection, missing table, missing required rows, unverified-only rows, query failure, or invalid values all return None with a logged warning — callers render 'Not assessed', never a default figure

functions.name: run_cdc_screen
functions.input: validated standards dict plus CdcScreenInputs of three-state property facts where None means the fact could not be determined
functions.output: CdcScreenResult with eligible 'no' or 'maybe' (never 'yes'), cited exclusions, warnings, checks performed, and unchecked list
functions.if_none: garbage standards raise ValueError so callers must fail closed before calling; every None input lands in the unchecked list and a 'Not screened' warning instead of silently passing

functions.name: _validate_standards
functions.input: candidate standards dict from the loader or from a direct caller
functions.output: normalised dict with finite positive minimum and non-empty string zone set, or None
functions.if_none: zero, negative, NaN, or non-numeric minimums and null or empty zone entries return None — shared by loader and engine so direct injection cannot bypass validation (Sol #816 lesson)

values.value: eligible_zones, min_lot_size (+conditionality), acid_sulfate_max_class rows from cdc_eligibility_standards where manual_verified
values.read_at: services/cdc_screen.py load_cdc_standards, validated by _validate_standards before use
values.if_missing: loader returns None; no screen runs; the consuming surface renders 'Not assessed' — enforced by tests test_missing_required_rows_returns_none and test_corrupt_values_return_none

queries.purpose: load verified CDC standards for one complying-development code
queries.where_clause: WHERE code_name = %s AND manual_verified = TRUE AND is_active = TRUE — unverified or retired rows invisible; duplicate active rows fail closed in the loader

break_it.scenario: Seed rows land in the table but the founder has not reviewed them, and the engine starts screening against unreviewed regulatory values.
break_it.what_happens: Unverified extraction errors would drive definite 'no' verdicts in a paid report.
break_it.how: The loader's WHERE clause reads manual_verified = TRUE only; test_query_filters_to_verified_rows pins the clause text so removing the filter fails the suite.
break_it.repro: Insert a row with manual_verified=false and call load_cdc_standards — it returns None (no other verified rows exist).

break_it.scenario: A corrupt standards row (zero minimum, null zone entry) loads and every lot passes the minimum or rendering crashes.
break_it.what_happens: Same defect class as the Sol #816 findings: silent universal pass or mid-report TypeError.
break_it.how: _validate_standards rejects non-finite/non-positive minimums and non-string zones at BOTH the loader and the engine boundary; run_cdc_screen raises on garbage rather than screening. Tests cover 0/NaN/inf/negative minimums and null/empty zone entries at both layers.

break_it.scenario: A caller cannot fetch some property fact (zone unknown, layer query failed) and the screen silently treats it as passing.
break_it.what_happens: A 'maybe' verdict that looks fully screened when constraints were never checked.
break_it.how: Every input is three-state; None lands in result.unchecked plus a 'Not screened (data unavailable)' warning naming each constraint. test_unknown_inputs_surface_as_unchecked_not_silent_pass pins it.
break_it.repro: run_cdc_screen(standards, CdcScreenInputs()) — all facts None — returns maybe with all constraints listed as unchecked.

break_it.scenario: Someone re-adds the TS route's hardcoded zone list or thresholds to the engine during PR-2 porting.
break_it.what_happens: The hardcoded-regulatory-data defect this whole consolidation exists to remove returns in the new home.
break_it.how: test_engine_source_contains_no_regulatory_constants greps the module source for the zone-list literals, 200m/8.5/0.3 figures, and CDC_ELIGIBLE_ZONES; any reappearance fails the suite.
break_it.repro: Add CDC_ELIGIBLE_ZONES = ['R1', 'R2'] to cdc_screen.py and run tests/test_cdc_screen.py.

break_it.scenario: A nearby EPA register site gets rendered as a CDC exclusion for the subject lot.
break_it.what_happens: Overstated legal claim about a neighbour's contamination — the #807 wording rule (proximity, never subject-lot contamination) violated in a new surface.
break_it.how: Severity mapping is structural: only contaminated_lot_on_register produces an exclusion; contamination_within_500m produces a warning that explicitly says it does not exclude the lot. test_contamination_nearby_is_warning_only pins it.
break_it.repro: run_cdc_screen(standards, inputs with contamination_within_500m=True) — verdict stays maybe.

post_merge.db_reset: Migration 058 must be applied (additive CREATE TABLE only; touches no existing table, no backup content exists to lose). Until applied AND seeded AND rows verified, the engine loader returns None everywhere — nothing renders differently.
post_merge.secrets: No secrets involved — engine takes an injected connection.
post_merge.other_repo: None. PR-2 (wire PDF row + swap /api/cdc/preliminary-check internals, delete its TS hardcodes) and the founder-reviewed seeding step are tracked in issue #820 / plan ce-cdc-screen-consolidation-2026-07.
post_merge.manual_verify: Yes - after seeding+verification: a property in a mapped exclusion area returns 'no' citing the layer; an all-clear property returns 'maybe' (never 'yes'); a property with unknown zone lists zone under 'Not screened'.
